mechanisms.title: Text Determination
mechanisms.memory_hook: Text is master data with a search strategy.
mechanisms.question: Which text should appear here, and where did it come from?
mechanisms.determination: For each configured text type, the access sequence searches potential source texts in order and copies/links the selected text into the SD document according to the text rules.

failure_modes.prove: Check procedure assignment → text type → access sequence → source text existence → copy/reference behavior.

failure_modes.symptom: Old text survives into a follow-on document
failure_modes.prove: Check whether the target copies predecessor text or redetermines from master data.

tests.setup: Maintain a customer-material text and configure it as a source for an item text.
tests.assert: Sales item receives the text when no higher-priority source wins.

mechanisms.title: Output Management
mechanisms.memory_hook: The document exists. Output decides who actually hears about it.
mechanisms.question: What message is produced, for whom, through which channel, with which form and timing?
mechanisms.determination: Output parameter determination evaluates business rules to determine output items and parameters such as channel, recipient, form template, email template and dispatch time.

failure_modes.symptom: Document posted but customer receives nothing
failure_modes.prove: Check output item creation → determination rules → recipient → channel → dispatch time/status → rendering/send error.
Trace decision-table result and partner data before editing the template.

tests.setup: Configure a rule that sends email for one sales organization and print for another.
tests.assert: Output parameters follow the decision-table conditions and create visible output items.
